entries.title: Psalms 96:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: O sing - Upon this new and great occasion, not the removal of the ark, but the coming of the Messiah.

entries.title: Psalms 96:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Gods - The gods of the nations, as the next verse expounds it.

entries.title: Psalms 96:9
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Beauty - Cloathed with all the gifts and graces, which are necessary in God's worship.

entries.title: Psalms 96:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Reigneth - God hath now set up his kingdom in the world. Established - The nations of the world shall by the means of it enjoy an established and lasting peace.

entries.title: Psalms 96:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Before - At the presence and approach of their Lord and Maker. Cometh - To set up his throne among all the nations of the earth.
